cohort: 17,048 women with singleton pregnancies who had received ART from 2005 to 2018 in the US
finding: Higher BMI in pregnant women who received ART was independently associated with increased risk for adverse maternal outcomes such as pre-eclampsia and eclampsia, gestational diabetes, DIC, longer hospital stays, and higher rates of Cesarean delivery, while risk was not increased for fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with higher BMI.
